prompt:
Audit only source applicability, independently of whether the ethical conclusion is attractive. For EVERY supplied statement, separate its decisive factual components and conditions from normative principles. Copy exact claim_span substrings. Check each added qualifier, role, absence claim, mental state, quantifier, modality and necessity condition against the FULL source. SOURCE_SUPPORTED means the quoted source supports that precise component, not merely that a quote exists. CONTRADICTED needs contrary source support. Missing information is NOT_ESTABLISHED, never the opposite fact. NORMATIVE_ASSUMPTION identifies a moral principle needing argument, not a factual error. CONDITIONAL_PRECONDITION identifies a genuinely hypothetical factual antecedent not established in this case; it must remain a condition when the norm is applied. Do not let a moral principle hide unstated factual applicability. Cite exact source spans for source judgments. Preserve whatever weaker factual or conditional reading survives. Do not recommend an action or decide duty priority.

The patient is unconscious. An on-call physician needs the allergy information to choose treatment safely. Sharing the allergy entry only with that physician may prevent a dangerous reaction, but success is not guaranteed. The stated policy contains no emergency exception. Mara proposes sharing only the relevant entry to obtain treatment, rather than publishing the record. Should she share it?"}], "claims": [{"statement_id": "STATEMENT:110923ebec368bce73950cb0", "text": "If disclosing the minimum information to a treating physician is the only timely way to avert serious and otherwise unavoidable harm to the same patient, then one ought to disclose exactly that minimum.", "polarity": "AFFIRMED", "modality": "ASSERTED"}, {"statement_id": "STATEMENT:38eecd7c8efb938f35903638", "text": "One ought to obey institutional confidentiality policies unless a higher-priority moral duty overrides them.", "polarity": "AFFIRMED", "modality": "ASSERTED"}, {"statement_id": "STATEMENT:5494daaf17ae2180fded451a", "text": "Therefore, Mara ought to share only the allergy entry with the on-call physician.", "polarity": "AFFIRMED", "modality": "ASSERTED"}, {"statement_id": "STATEMENT:b0e524e821c0bdd3c58f9217", "text": "\"Sharing the allergy entry only with that physician may prevent a dangerous reaction, but success is not guaranteed.\"", "polarity": "AFFIRMED", "modality": "ASSERTED"}, {"statement_id": "STATEMENT:be2c357a76c64c3aef36b0d8", "text": "Preventing an imminent, serious harm to the patient has moral priority over keeping information confidential, provided the disclosure is strictly limited to what is necessary.", "polarity": "AFFIRMED", "modality": "ASSERTED"}]}
